not_established: CHPT: the face classes it TOO_FEW (one comparable date, 2025-05-23, close 14.48 against a sale at 0.717, ratio 20.2); the custodian rows carry no other trade of it, so a constant scale or a step cannot be told from one pair

Coverage: 3109 share-priced securities traded; 1409 have any close in the build table; 720 have at least one same-date pair; 346 of those 720 have fewer than 3 pairs (TOO_FEW). The store holds a security only from its first held day in the served window, so 26821 of 34810 trade dates of in-store securities fall before the security's first stored close and are not comparable

Fixed Income: 753 securities traded by/sl, 180 present in the build table, 0 same-date pairs, so no unit (price per 100 par or per unit) was established and none is reported; options: none appear in the cache; annuities, alternative investments, cash and cash equivalents left out

CONSTANT_SCALE needs a stable ratio over the comparable dates only: a security whose trades all fall before an event (XLB, FDX) is CONSTANT_SCALE here and cannot be told from a STEP whose other side has no trade; the factor is the median ratio, a close over a traded price, not a proven cause

Trade price is |Amount| / |Quantity| per (cusip, Trade_Date), quantity-weighted; Amount may carry fees or accrued interest, so a ratio within a few percent of 1 is not read as an error and the 5 and 10 percent bounds are the face bounds

Reach: priced holding rows are account_day_value rows of the security with a non-null value; measured = the same (account, date) has a non-null return in daily_returns. holding_days_affected for a STEP excludes the days between the last comparable date of one side and the first of the other (reported as holding_days_in_gap_between_sides): the break lies in that gap and is not located

The classes follow the rules in the .md (tolerant stable test: at least 90 percent of dates within 5 percent of the median; STEP needs 3 or more dates a side and the about-1 side within 2 percent of 1); all 5 CONSTANT_SCALE securities also pass the strict all-dates reading
The cause of any ratio (dividend or spin-off adjusted close, a split applied the wrong way, a wrong source) is not established here

by_store._note: each store block re-runs the same classer on only the pairs whose close came from that store; a security with pairs from two stores appears in both blocks, so block securities sum to more than the total
